## Failure family A — H5 unmatched after project-name target

Project `41cebac1-744f-4dbf-87f7-009c8baa489a` (`HO isolate ho-baseline-1`).

Capture context was project-scoped and correct: **0 To Dos, 0 Milestones, 2 Stakeholders** (Elena Voss, Tomos Reed).

Both observations were **rejected** (`invalidTargetCount=2`, `observationAccount.rejected=2`):

1. Huddle chair — `AMBIGUOUS` / `invalidTarget=true`. Proposed op `NO_CHANGE` stakeholder, `targetTitle` = **project name** `HO isolate ho-baseline-1`.
2. Depot void keys 16 Oct — `AMBIGUOUS` / `invalidTarget=true`. Proposed op `NO_CHANGE` todo, `targetTitle` = **same project name**, values `{ title: "Collect void keys from the depot", date: "2026-10-16" }`.

Review painted two Needs You “which record?” cards against the project title. The independently safe dated create never became Apply-ready.

This is the hosted Family 3 class already named in `e2e-hosted-vertical/baselines/capture-defect-families-hv-trace-20260911T201500Z.md` §6–§8: extract binds the project UUID/name; validate `foreign_id` / `invalidTarget` rejects it; a legal create becomes unmatched Needs You. The original Ambiguity journey hid this when extract emitted `create_new` against a milestone-shaped sibling. The holdout used a **new dated To Do** with no in-project todo, and the miss reproduced.

Excerpt: [`first-run-untouched/h5-capture-excerpt.json`](./first-run-untouched/h5-capture-excerpt.json)

## Failure family B — H6 in-project create blocked by another project’s todo

Project `b543aeae-b12b-491e-b9fd-6a6ca5d52077` (`HO messy ho-baseline-1`).

Workshop update and Kwame create were correct. Plants were not written. Speculative DHP stayed Needs You (allowed).

Void keys finding was `NEW_INFORMATION` / todo create, `invalidTarget=false`. Capture context counts: **To Dos: 0**. Review still asked:

> Is this a new to do or the existing “Collect void keys from depot” to do?

That existing todo `cbe8a70f-…` belongs to **another project** `e07fc1e7-…` created earlier in this same holdout run (H2). Workspace MissionState listed it; project-scoped Capture context did not.

So H6’s independently safe create was blocked by **workspace-wide identity matching**, not by missing extract.
